tools.description: Get details of a specific build result

tools.name: bamboo_get_build_result_expanded
tools.description: Get expanded build result with changes, artifacts, metadata, comments, labels, JIRA issues, stages, and log URLs. Use this when you need detailed build information including what changed and deployment artifacts.

tools.name: bamboo_get_build_repositories
tools.description: Get the repositories and commits (VCS revisions) associated with a specific build. Returns repository names, commit IDs, authors, and branch info. Use this to find which repo/commit was released in a build.

tools.name: bamboo_get_plan_repositories
tools.description: Get the repositories linked to a Bamboo plan (VCS locations). Shows all source repositories configured for the plan. Use this to see which repos a plan tracks.

tools.name: bamboo_get_build_queue
tools.description: Get the current build queue

tools.name: bamboo_list_deployment_projects
tools.description: List deployment projects (default: 10, truncated client-side from full list)

maxResult.description: Maximum number of deployment projects to return (default: 10)

tools.name: bamboo_list_deployment_projects_for_plan
tools.description: List deployment projects linked to a specific build plan

tools.name: bamboo_get_deployment_project
tools.description: Get details of a specific deployment project

tools.name: bamboo_get_environment_results
tools.description: Get deployment history/results for a specific environment. Returns who deployed, when, status, version, and deployment result IDs.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: bamboo_get_deployment_result
tools.description: Get full details of a specific deployment result including who triggered it, start/finish time, status, deployment version, and agent info.

tools.name: bamboo_list_deploy_versions
tools.description: List versions (releases) for a deployment project. Shows release names, creation dates, and associated plan branch.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of versions to return (default: 10)

tools.name: bamboo_get_deploy_version
tools.description: Get details of a specific deployment version/release including name, creation date, creator, plan branch, and items.

tools.name: bamboo_get_deploy_version_status
tools.description: Get the deployment status of a specific version across all environments. Shows which environments have this version deployed and their status.

tools.name: bamboo_get_plan_context
tools.description: Get the plan context knowledge configuration. Returns naming conventions for plans, deployment environments, modules, and actions. Use this to understand how plans and deployments are structured.

tools.name: bamboo_reload_context
tools.description: Reload the plan context configuration from the context.yaml file. Use after editing the config.

tools.name: bamboo_resolve_plan
tools.description: Resolve a human-friendly reference name to a full Bamboo plan key. For example: reference='CHECKOUT' with planType='app' resolves to 'EXAMPLE-CHECKOUTAPP'. Searches Bamboo if direct lookup fails.

planType.description: Plan type: 'app', 'infra'. If omitted, tries direct key lookup.

tools.name: bamboo_get_deploy_status
tools.description: Smart deployment status checker. Resolves a reference to a plan, gets latest build status, finds deployment projects, filters environments, and fetches per-environment deployment history (who, when, status, version). Returns build status, deployment environments with latest deployment details, and Bamboo UI links.

planType.description: Plan type: 'app', 'infra'. If omitted, tries direct key lookup.

tools.name: bamboo_explain_environment
tools.description: Parse a deployment environment name into its components (env, module, ref, action) using plan context knowledge. When the plan type declares modules, it resolves the module name and description. Provide planType for accurate parsing.

tools.name: bamboo_get_plan_type_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific plan type including its naming format, environment format, available actions with descriptions, modules, log patterns for success detection, custom inputs, and hints.
